defects.defect: Large empty sand expanse in the middle and right of the arena; props (rocks, skulls, cactus) are clustered on the left edge, so dressing does not fill the width and the environment reads unfinished
defects.direction: Distribute props evenly across the arena width and add mid-field dressing to balance the left-heavy clustering

defects.defect: A miniature goblin sprite is rendered at a fraction of the other goblins' scale, breaking sprite-scale consistency
defects.direction: Render all goblins at the same scale as the two large goblins, or remove the stray tiny sprite

defects.defect: A pink-flower cactus prop is drawn on top of the Ember mage's head, reading as an accidental overlap rather than intentional dressing; sprite depth sorting is wrong
defects.direction: Sort props behind/away from unit sprites or move the prop out of the mage's footprint so no decoration overlaps a character
defects.region: Ember mage sprite, ~(240-340, 780-960) — flower/cactus prop overlapping his head

defects.defect: The ranged mage is isolated far from the other two, near the bottom-right edge, with no camp ledge anchoring; the trio does not read as a formation, and the two melee mages are not advancing toward the goblins in any legible way
defects.direction: Place the ranged mage on the camp ledge near the tent on the left and stage the melee mages forward as a coherent front line

defects.defect: The stage track is clipped at the screen's left edge — nodes are half cut off and the rail sits partly outside the safe area; it also floats over the sand with no frame or background plate
defects.direction: Inset the track ~16-24px from the left edge and give it a framed rail so nodes are fully visible
defects.region: Stage track, left edge x≈0-40, y≈460-1100

defects.defect: A flowering-cactus prop overlaps the melee mage sprite, reading as clutter stuck to the character
defects.direction: Move arena props out of hero walk paths or draw heroes above props so sprites read cleanly

defects.defect: Name labels are left-aligned against the portrait ring with inconsistent trailing space, and each uses a different saturated color with no shared outline treatment
defects.direction: Unify name styling with consistent outline and consistent left inset across all three cards

defects.defect: The large empty gap between the advancing goblins and frontline heroes makes the encounter feel slightly disconnected.
defects.direction: Bring the active combatants closer or add subtle combat/dressing elements through the center.

defects.defect: Large empty sand band between the goblin line and the hero group with only sparse pebble scatter
defects.direction: Tighten the engagement distance or add mid-density dressing so the arena reads as a finished environment

defects.defect: HP bars are full-width solid green slabs with no frame or fill/track distinction, and sit tight against the name row; they read as flat blocks rather than framed bars
defects.direction: Add a dark track and border to each HP bar and increase vertical breathing room from the name

defects.defect: The speed chip and pause button are different shapes and visual weights, and the pause button's brown plate is misaligned — it overhangs the wooden frame's right/top border
defects.direction: Match the two controls' size and inset, and keep the pause plate inside the frame border
defects.region: Top strip, speed chip '1x' at ~(40-125, 240-295) vs pause at ~(610-700, 230-300)

defects.defect: No visible damage numbers or hit feedback, so combat readability is not demonstrated.
defects.direction: Add brief, high-contrast damage/heal numbers and impact effects near the active melee exchange.

defects.defect: No damage numbers or combat contact visible; melee mages are far from the goblins, so battle readability can't be assessed and the scene reads static
defects.direction: Show mages engaging enemies with legible floating damage numbers per the spec

defects.defect: No damage numbers or combat feedback present, so readability of damage text cannot read as designed
defects.direction: Show floating damage numbers with outline/shadow over the sand

defects.direction: Spawn goblins fully below the framed header, or clip them with a soft arena edge instead of a hard frame cut
defects.region: top of arena, both goblins ~(180,380) and ~(590,380)
